description: Opaque muted plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, edged with gold woven geometric and floral trim around the neckline, shoulder straps, sleeve ends, center front and skirt hem. Small round gold clasps sit at the shoulders, and a narrow patterned belt with round central clasp marks the waist. A cream opaque underdress is visible through the front skirt opening. A cream wrap with fine gold borders rests along the forearms and falls beside the skirt. A gold pendant necklace and an ornate gold-patterned closed shoe are visible. No armor, headgear or weapon is present.
